title: build(deps): Bump the npm_and_yarn group across 2 directories with 2 updates
body:
Bumps the npm_and_yarn group with 1 update in the /apps/console directory: [happy-dom](https://github.com/capricorn86/happy-dom). Bumps the npm_and_yarn group with 1 update in the /apps/site directory: [next](https://github.com/vercel/next.js). Updates `happy-dom` from 20.11.2 to 21.0.4
Release notes

Sourced from happy-dom's releases.

v21.0.4

:construction_worker_man: Patch fixes

  • Fixed a code injection vulnerability in the ESM compiler - By @​capricorn86
  • Fixed cross-origin isolation so opaque-origin data: iframes cannot access their parent or top window - By @​capricorn86

v21.0.3

:construction_worker_man: Patch fixes

  • Fixes security vulnerability where authorization header was forwarded when redirecting - By @​capricorn86

v21.0.2

:construction_worker_man: Patch fixes

  • Fixes SSRF security vulnerability by doing a target-origin bypass in the proxy server in @​happy-dom/server-renderer - By @​capricorn86

v21.0.1

:construction_worker_man: Patch fixes

  • Adds aliases --css and --iframe for enabling CSS and iframe loading to @​happy-dom/server-renderer - By @​capricorn86

v21.0.0

:bomb: Breaking Changes

  • Disables CSS and IFrame loading by default to prevent server-side request forgery (SSRF) - By @​capricorn86
    • An attacker could embed <iframe> or <link rel="stylesheet"> elements in untrusted HTML to make Happy DOM send HTTP requests from the server to attacker-chosen URLs, including internal services. This could allow access to otherwise unreachable endpoints or trigger unintended actions, depending on the application and its network access.
    • The settings property disableCSSFileLoading has been deprecated
    • Added the new settings properties enableCSSFileLoading and enableIframePageLoading
    • If you don't believe that you are at risk, you can keep the same behavior as in <=v20.14.6 by sending in { enableCSSFileLoading: true, enableIframePageLoading: true } as broswer settings (e.g. new Window({ settings }));

v20.14.6

:construction_worker_man: Patch fixes

  • Fixes cookie scope forgery vulnerability - By @​capricorn86

v20.14.5

:construction_worker_man: Patch fixes

  • Preserve character references in comment data - By @​hampustagerud in task #2409

v20.14.4

:construction_worker_man: Patch fixes

  • End comments at the first comment end tag when it overlaps a comment start tag - By @​hampustagerud in task #2407

v20.14.3

:construction_worker_man: Patch fixes

  • Avoids cloning all properties in CSSPropertyManager.toString - By @​erictheswift in task #2363

v20.14.2

:construction_worker_man: Patch fixes

  • Fixes regression where not all CSS variables where resolved in getComputedStyle() - By @​klaesra in task #2344

v20.14.1

:construction_worker_man: Patch fixes

  • Invalidate the computed style cache for the whole subtree - By @​matmannion and @​capricorn86 in task #2366

v20.14.0

Updates `next` from 16.3.8 to 16.4.1
Release notes

Sourced from next's releases.

v16.4.1

This release contains security fixes for the following advisories:

Critical:

  • Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in use cache functions returning typed arrays
  • Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in Image Optimization API when SVG files are used

High:

  • Denial of Service in App Router using Server Actions

v16.4.0

Check out the 16.4 announcement post to get an overview of the changes.

Core Changes

  • Show compiler plugin warning in more situations: #75682
  • fix(scripts): correct typo in rm.mjs error message: #87015
  • docs: improve clarity and punctuation in README: #86096
  • Fix debug build paths Pages Router support entries: #93529
  • bundle-analyzer: record historical snapshots on each analyze run: #93520
  • fix: detect proxy.ts correctly with compound pageExtensions: #93246
  • feat(turbopack): support false values for resolveAlias config: #93331

Misc Changes

  • docs: correction to dynamicParams migration: #96624
  • docs: proxy event argument: #96435
  • docs: remove experimental note from runtime prefetching: #96615
  • Preserve per-segment prefetching after dynamic navigation: #96583
  • Rename static generation stream option to waitForAllReady: #96564
  • Remove obsolete static generation plumbing: #96563
  • [turbopack] Drop dead writes to exports: #96381
  • [turbopack] Ignore writes to exports after a module.exports = {} writes: #96380
  • [turbopack] Add test for sideEffects with optimizePackageImports: #96549
  • [turbopack] Strip leading BOM before parsing CSS: #96678
  • Upgrade React from cbb046ab-20260731 to 7dfc7ccd-20260803: #96550
  • docs: use relative doc links in instant-navigation error pages: #96672
  • Turbopack: terminate failed plugin worker threads: #96592
  • Fix HTML-limited bot matching in prerender bypass rules: #96584
  • [ci] Fix create_release_branch for new repo permissions: #96641
  • test: skip action module instance deploy test: #96629
  • docs: quote the dynamicParams build error in a blockquote: #96633
  • [react-sync] Open pull requests as the bot that authors the commits: #96682
  • [Bench] Fixes for pure Fizz bench: #96771
  • Derive foreground cache revalidation from the consumer: #96731
  • Fix race when navigating Back before hydration: #96252
  • docs: present each Skill as steps in the AI agents guide: #96751
  • Reuse completed cache entries for the rest of a request: #96727
  • Upgrade React from 7dfc7ccd-20260803 to 11eddecd-20260805: #96735
  • Remove WorkStore execution mode: #96674
